title: Find where the funnel breaks
goal_md: Completion is down 14 percent this week. Pull the step-level counts you need to find where in the funnel the drop concentrates before forming any hypothesis about a cause.

preload.context_md:
## What you know so far

- Checkout completion fell 14 percent on Tuesday.
- No incident has been declared and support has not flagged anything unusual.

required_moves.label: Groups events by funnel step to locate the concentration point

fail_conditions: Learner names a specific root cause before running any query.

title: Rule out a volume artifact
goal_md: The drop concentrates between submit_order and order_confirmed. Isolate whether the regression is specific to one payment provider, and check the historical baseline before you name a cause.

preload.context_md:
## What you know so far

- Step-level counts show the drop concentrates between submit_order and order_confirmed.
- No cause has been named yet.

required_moves.label: Breaks payment failures down by provider

detector.prompt: Did the learner isolate payment failure rate by provider AND check that provider's historical baseline before naming a cause?

bonus_moves.label: Explicitly checks the historical baseline before concluding

fail_conditions: Learner escalates to another team without checking the historical baseline first.
